messages.author: 30dc0c001c553eb0
messages.subject: JGR.app not working with MacOS 10.11
parts:
After upgrading from MacOs 10.10.5 to 10.11 (El Capitan), the JGR application won't start up any more; keeps crashing on launch.
Apple legacy java 1.6 is installed, as is the latest oracle java, jdk 1.8.0_60.
I normally use the app to launch JGR/Deducer on the Mac. However, as a work around, JGR and Deducer can still be launched via the R console.  That works.
Any suggestions. Thanks.

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: JGR.app not working with MacOS 10.11
parts:
Have not tried on el capitan. r-sig-rosuda is the right place to bring up a jgr launcher issue. As a work around, you can copy the commands emitted when you run JGR() into a text file called runjgr.command. Mine looks like

#!/bin/sh

export R_HOME="/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources"
export R_ARCH=""
export R_LIBS="/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library"
export R_LIBS_USER="~/Library/R/3.2/library"
'/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/1.6.0.jdk/Contents/Home/bin/java' -cp '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/rJava/java/boot' -Drjava.class.path='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/rJava/jri/JRI.jar:/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/iplots/java/iplots.jar:/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/JGR/java/JGR.jar:/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/etc/classes:/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/etc/classes/classes.jar' -Drjava.path='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/rJava' -Dmain.class=org.rosuda.JGR.JGR  -Djgr.load.pkgs=yes  -Dr.arch= -Xdock:icon='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/JGR/icons/JGR.icns' -Dcom.apple.mrj.application.apple.menu.about.name='JGR' -Xdock:name='JGR' -Dapple.laf.useScreenMenuBar=true -Dcom.apple.macos.useScreenMenuBar=true -Xrs -Xss5m RJavaClassLoader 


Then make it executable with

chmod +x runjgr.command

and should now be able to double click on it.


Best,
Ian

messages.author: 30dc0c001c553eb0
messages.subject: Re: JGR.app not working with MacOS 10.11
parts:
Thanks Ian.
As I said I am still able to start up JGR + Deducer from R console via JGR().
I get the same output as you. 
Your are right this can be copied into terminal and will fire up JGR as well that way.
As indicated by "1.6.0.jdk" it falls back to apple legacy java, although I have the latest oracle jdk installed for general use.
It can also be instructed to use the latest oracle jdk instead of the apple legacy version, if installed of course, by replacing "1.6.0.jdk" with the appropriate oracle jdk path (jdk1.8.0_60.jdk) in the terminal command.
This works well, too.
Don't believe the issue is directly related to JGR. I think there is some sort of specific issue in the interaction of MacOsX.10.11 (El Cap), oracle java and rjava that the rjava developers are aware of and it will probably get addressed with the next rjava update.
Tried rjava 0.9-8 from rforge, but this fails to install from source on my mac.
In the meantime not a disaster though, all still working. 
I should mention that all my packages are up to date and the latest binaries from cran.


Best
Rudolf
